newsitem.title: GREECE: SERB STRIKER IVIC CHARGED FOR PUNCHING GIRLFRIEND.
newsitem.headline: SERB STRIKER IVIC CHARGED FOR PUNCHING GIRLFRIEND.

text.p: Serb international striker Ilia Ivic has been charged for punching his Greek girlfriend, Eleni Petroulaki, a television aerobics instructor, who now recovers in hospital, police said on Monday.
They said Ivic punched Petroulaki in the face a number of times early on Friday outside her house and then dissapeared to escape arrest.

"The prosecutor ordered his arrest so as to stand trial immediately. According to law he must be arrested within 48 hours of the order, and if not, another court date will be set. The prosecutor will decide whether he still wants him arrested," a police official told Reuters.
Ivic and Petroulaki have been dating for two years.
Ivic is among the best strikers in the Greek first division soccer championship and plays for league leader Olympiakos.
Petroulaki is Greece's best known gymnast with a series of shows on television. Her lawyer said Ivic lost control when Petroulaki told him that their relationship was over.
Olympiakos' Serb coach Dusan Bayevic said the club would not get involved in Ivic's personal matters but condemned the attack.
